card.name: Words just before 'witness' or 'witnessed'
card.fires_on: Words right before a likely 'witness', 'witnessed' or 'witnessing', such as 'eye-' in eye-witnesses, 'has' or 'are' before witnessed or witnessing, and 'before' in 'before God'. It also fires on 'for' after 'at risk' in an opioid-label sentence.

modes.label: Leads into witness
modes.description: A helper word or part-word just before a form of witness, as in seeing an event first hand.
modes.example: King herself<< has>> witnessed in the northwest Hawaiian Isles.

modes.label: Opioid risk phrase
modes.description: The word 'for' after 'close contacts at risk' in a repeated opioid label sentence.
modes.example: other close contacts at risk<< for>> accidental ingestion or opioid overdose.

modes.label: Onlookers and oaths
modes.description: Words where observers or a sworn presence is implied, like a crowd watching or vows before God.
modes.example: Dozens, perhaps even hundreds of<< students>>, gathered around to watch.
